about: The multiplayer servers the page offers. url: the WebSocket gateway of the server (crates/rustyac-gateway): a path on this site (/net/spa becomes wss://<this site>/net/spa) or a whole ws:// or wss:// address. cars: the models the server has, for the page's car list (any of them may be asked for). track (and layout): what the server runs, for AC's launcher's online list. password: true when the server asks for one.

servers.name: Laguna Seca (Ferrari F2004, BMW Z4 GT3)
